description:
Set the order of categories in the HelpCenter.io help center bound to your API key, in one call.

Requires a write-scoped API key. Prefer this over repeated helpcenter_update_category calls: an information architecture is decided all at once, and one call leaves no visibly half-sorted tree in between.

Args:
  - categories (array, required): the categories in the order you want them, as [{ id }] or [{ id, position }]. Omit 'position' on an entry and it takes its place in the list.

Order is per SIBLING GROUP — top-level categories sort against each other, and each parent's children against each other — so one payload may freely mix levels. It does not change any category's parent; use helpcenter_update_category's parent_id for that.

Returns: { status: "success", updated_count, categories: [...] } in the new order.

Errors: 403 if the key is read-scoped; 422 if any id is not a category of this help center.

agent_key.description: The api_key helpcenter_create_help_center returned for this help center, exactly as returned. Required on every call: this endpoint has no sign-in, so the key is how each call says which help center it acts on. It is sent to HelpCenter.io as this call's credential and nowhere else, and it is never shown again: keep it for the whole task, and never show it to the user or write it into content.

categories.description: The categories in the order you want them. Omit `position` on an entry to use its place in the list.

name: helpcenter_reorder_categories
title: Reorder HelpCenter Categories
